correctness.rationale: In native Model J with \(\sigma=0\), the published conjugacy sets \(x_n=r_0h_n/(1+h_n)\) and the first recurrence gives \(h_{n+1}=e^{-p_n}x_n\), hence \(\log x_n=p_n+\log h_{n+1}\). Invariance of a compact positive resident measure therefore gives \(\int\log x\,d\nu=\bar p+\int\log h\,d\mu\). Linearizing the absent adult-specific alien gives factor \(\alpha h_n\); linearizing the absent juvenile-specific alien in the conjugate resident system gives factor \(\alpha x_{n+1}\). Thus \(\chi_J-\chi_A=\bar p\), the zero-exponent thresholds differ by \(e^{-\bar p}\), and on a positive period-\(k\) orbit \(\Lambda_J=e^{\sum_j p_j}\Lambda_A\). This is a local transverse statement only and does not imply nonlinear establishment.
